newsitem.title: UK: OUTLOOK-Palladium turns volatile after new highs.
newsitem.headline: OUTLOOK-Palladium turns volatile after new highs.

text.p: LONDON - Palladium, Cinderella of the precious metals, rockets to its highest since the end of the 1970s on renewed concerns about delayed Russian supply. Then it whipsaws after Japanese traders say clients were told, in talks with the Russians, that exports are expected to resume around June 20.
** Expect spot cover with a wrap of the news from various datelines, background and analysts views in the upcoming London precious metals report around 1130 GMT.
